name: baton
description: Baton is a Claude Code plugin: hooks that keep every task in a folder with a logbook. A session opens on the board of what is whose move, a turn that leaves work unrecorded is handed back, a message naming a task brings up its record. Hooks run in Claude Code (terminal, IDE, desktop Code tab); in claude.ai chat only the skills load. Installed from claude.ai? Open Claude Code on the same account. The hooks make no network requests; the opt-in review tools, run by hand, send text to OpenRouter.

tasks_folder.title: Task folder
tasks_folder.description: Where your task folders live: one folder per task, each with its logbook. Created at the first session if it is missing; Baton only reads it and names what it finds.

logbook.title: Logbook file name
logbook.description: The file in each task folder that holds its record, newest entry first. Use a word in your own language if you prefer.
